name: Quality Minus Junk (Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen 2019) — Feasibility Screen
source: Asness, C.S., Frazzini, A. & Pedersen, L.H. (2019), 'Quality Minus Junk', AQR White Paper / Rev. Acc. Stud.

qmj_components.profitability: Gross Profit / Total Assets, ROE, ROA, CFO/Assets -> income + balance + cashflow
qmj_components.growth: 5-yr growth in profitability, sustainable growth -> balance sheet
qmj_components.safety: Low leverage (D/E) -> balance sheet; low vol + low beta -> PRICE (available)
qmj_components.payout: Dividend yield -> dividends (available, E026 confirmed); share-repurchase yield -> cashflow financing

rationale: yfinance free-tier quarterly income statements / balance sheets / cash-flow statements return only the trailing ~5-8 quarters (most recent ~2025-06 onward) for every probed ticker, far below the ~126 quarters required for a 2014-2026 504-day-formation walk-forward (504 trading days ~ 126 quarters). Earliest available income-statement column is in 2025, so a formation window cannot close before ~2027. Price/vol and dividend proxies ARE available from 2014 (E026 confirmed), but the profitability/growth/leverage components of QMJ are infeasible on yfinance.
decision: DATA-INFEASIBLE - QMJ is an accounting-composite quality factor (profitability, growth, safety-leverage, payout). Profitability, growth and leverage-safety all require quarterly income-statement/balance-sheet/cash-flow data, which yfinance does not provide for the 2014-2026 period (only ~5-8 trailing quarters). This is the same hard constraint that made E029 (GP/AG), E031 (accruals) and E032 (PEAD) infeasible. The price-only proxies (dividend yield, vol, beta) are available but form a strict subset of QMJ; a partial-proxy quality factor is out-of-scope for the pre-registered composite gate. No OOS Sharpe gate evaluated. Do NOT commit full compute.
